topics.topic: Handling stale approvals when request digest changes (re-request/replace/wait vs other authority paths)
questions: If an existing approval no longer matches the built request and a standing grant is active, must the kernel still ask again, or may it send under the grant?
When a pending `requested` approval becomes stale (new request digest), does the kernel replace it with a new `requested` approval or keep waiting on the old one?

topics.topic: Allowed cardinality for a mapped node's `map_over` input port
questions: Must a `map_over` port itself be cardinality `one` (receiving each element), or can it be `many`?

topics.topic: Canonical header set/normalization used for `request_digest` and approval matching
questions: Does "every header the kernel sends" include transport-library implicit headers (e.g., Host, Content-Length, Connection, User-Agent) or only headers explicitly set by kernel rules?
Is multipart `Content-Type` boundary parameter part of approval matching (via headers), and if not, how is it normalized?

topics.topic: Deterministic element-order rule for reporting first failure in list-valued validation
questions: When multiple elements in one list input are invalid, what exact element-order rule determines the reported failure?

topics.topic: Exact path placeholder grammar and malformed-brace handling
questions: What exact grammar defines `{name}` placeholders in paths (allowed characters, escaping/literal braces, malformed brace handling, repeated placeholder names)?

topics.topic: Failure precedence across validation stages (which failed check is reported first)
questions: When a request both fails the slot/flow purpose rule and also fails an earlier surface check (schema, unknown operation, authorization), which failure must be returned first?

topics.topic: Output disclosure classification for mapped-node empty-output cases
questions: If a mapped node has non-mapped `personal_data` inputs but maps over an empty list, what class must its empty-list outputs carry?

topics.topic: Pagination/list ordering behavior when mutable entities change status
questions: When an entity changes status, does its list order position change (treated as 'newest') or stay at original creation position?

topics.topic: Required granularity of refusal reasons (bundled check vs specific subcondition)
questions: Must refusal detail distinguish the exact subcondition inside a bundled check, or is naming the bundled check itself sufficient?

topics.topic: Response output shape for non-terminal runs (all outputs vs only produced outputs)
questions: For `running`/`awaiting_approval`/`pending` runs, must the response include all flow outputs (with a placeholder/reason), or only currently produced outputs?

topics.topic: Return semantics of `approve` when approval succeeds but downstream send cannot occur
questions: What does the approve operation return in that case: success for the decision only, or refusal/failure because no send happened?

topics.topic: Selection/consumption rule when multiple matching approved-unused approvals exist
questions: If multiple approved-unused approvals match the same send, which one is consumed and recorded as authority?

topics.topic: Semantics of an explicitly empty try/case selection list
questions: Does an explicit empty case list count as "names none" (run all cases) or as an invalid selection (refuse)?
